sections.Profile:
Data East's Jurassic Park came out in 1993, the same year as the film, designed by Joe Kaminkow and Ed Cebula with art by Markus Rothkranz. A T-Rex on the playfield eats the ball, a raptor kicks it back, and a shaker motor rattles the cabinet. The plunger is a gun grip, and its "Smart Missile" trigger scores every lit feature at once, a nod to the same button on Defender . Data East built 9,008 between April and August 1993.
